data.title: Building Shapes with Fixed Perimeter
data.description: Practice creating different geometric shapes on a grid that share the same given perimeter. Explore how figures with equal perimeters can have different areas.

challenges.narration: Each side of a square on the grid is one unit long.
challenges.instruction: Make a shape with a perimeter of 8 units.
challenges.hint: Walk around the outside of your shape and count each side of a square as you pass it.
